So degraded means fail whatever the count, a non-empty answer without it passes, and an empty answer without it is unavailable (no-results).
errorCategory: 401/403 auth, 404 not-found, any other 4xx refused, everything else transport.

The review's cleanups (sharedCount, checkA2/checkA3, one catch-all, no MalformedAnswer, no exitCode) keep every pre-existing output line the same; all earlier A2 and A3 tests pass unchanged except one build test that relied on an empty A1 answer passing, which now returns one result.

errorCategory checks the client's own transientStatus (5xx, 408, 429) before 401/403, 404 and other-4xx, so the two rules cannot drift; it applies to DispatchServiceError, DispatchGatewayError and readJson's HttpStatusError alike.
